headlines.headline: Arizona lands Clemson transfer RJ Godfrey as eligibility rulings reshape rosters
headlines.detail: Godfrey (12.0 ppg, 5.3 rpg) fills a frontcourt hole for Tommy Lloyd, made possible by a July 31 federal injunction granting a fifth season of eligibility to the 2022 high school class. Duke still opens as preseason No. 1.

headlines.headline: LeBron James signs with 76ers on what he calls his 'last decision'
headlines.detail: Two-year, $8 million deal joins James with Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown in Philadelphia, giving the Sixers three former Finals MVPs for 2026-27.

headlines.headline: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty carted off practice with apparent knee injury
headlines.detail: Jeanty was helped off unable to bear weight after an awkward landing, three weeks before the regular season opens; no severity update yet. Seattle closes Preseason Week 2 at Tennessee tonight.

headlines.headline: Alabama hands starting QB job to sophomore Keelon Russell over veteran Mack
headlines.detail: Russell wins the job less than two weeks before the Sept. 5 opener vs. East Carolina, as Ohio State opens preseason AP No. 1 ahead of the Aug. 29 Week 0 slate.
